svg.title: Shared crest frame
svg.desc: One frame for every crest: outer ink oval, paper lettering band, inner ink oval. The tree crest's own frame matched it within 0.38 units, so it was retired. Isolated from bc-ministry-primitives-v5/data/art.json → wildlifeFrame. Original coordinates retained; only the viewBox is cropped. Reference-based reconstruction, not an official master.
